title: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.35179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. translated_title: 高分背后的隐患：评估基于码本的LLM内容分析
translated_abstract: 大规模语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于计算社会科学中基于码本（codebook）的内容分析，其中码本将理论概念转化为标注方案。尽管先前的研究报告了强大的预测性能，但这些系统能否产生可靠且稳健的文本标注仍不清楚。我们对基于LLM的编码流程进行了大规模的实证失效模式分析，涵盖四个数据集和五个模型，通过在受控扰动、领域偏移和优化程序下系统地评估其稳定性、稳健性和概念有效性。我们发现了多种在标准指标下基本不可见的失效模式，表明高总体得分往往与严重的标签级别差异、跨运行的不稳定性、领域敏感性以及标签解释的转变共存。重要的是，这些失效模式在广泛使用的优化策略下依然持续存在。
tldr: 该研究通过跨四个数据集和五个模型的大规模实证分析，揭示基于LLM的码本内容分析尽管总体得分很高，却隐藏着标签级别差异、运行不稳定性和领域敏感性等被标准指标掩盖的失效模式，且这些失效在常用优化策略下依然存在。
en_tdlr: Large-scale empirical evaluation across four datasets and five models reveals that LLM-based codebook content analysis systems harbor hidden failure modes—including label-level disparities, run-to-run instability, and domain sensitivity—that remain invisible under standard metrics and persist despite widely used optimization strategies.
